description:
These red brick gutka tiles for outdoor walls are small brick-look tiles in natural fired terracotta, made by Pak Clay in Lahore for house fronts, boundary walls, garden paths, porches and courtyards.

## How they look
Gutka gives a surface the look of small red bricks laid in courses. The warm red comes from the clay itself rather than a coating, so the colour runs through the tile, and natural shade variation between pieces gives a wall a hand-built feel. This is the familiar Pakistani brick finish seen on older houses and garden walls.

## Where they work
- **Front elevations and boundary walls**, as clay brick facing tiles over plaster.
- **Garden walls, planters and gate pillars**.
- **Garden paths, porches and courtyards**: tell us if the tile is for a floor, so we can advise on use.

Terracotta gutka tiles are a traditional choice in hot climates, and clay tends to age well outdoors. For an indoor feature wall, see the [red gutka brick tiles for living rooms](/products/red-gutka-bricks-living-room-wall-tiles).

## Good to know
- Material: natural fired terracotta clay
- Look: small red brick
- Category: outdoor terracotta wall tiles
- Size, thickness and coverage per square foot: confirm on enquiry

Outdoors, clay can show white salt marks (efflorescence) as moisture moves through a wall; a sound, dry backing and good pointing help, and a breathable sealer is optional. Read [gutka tiles in Lahore](/blog/gutka-tiles-in-lahore-sizes-uses-and-how-to-choose) for sizes, or compare [red vs yellow gutka bricks](/blog/red-gutka-bricks-vs-yellow-gutka-bricks-which-to-pick).

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the brick tone and texture in daylight, then send your wall or floor area and city for a dated quote. Browse all [outdoor terracotta wall tiles](/categories/outdoor-wall-tiles-terracotta).

faqs.q: What is the price of red brick gutka tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the wall or floor area, the pattern, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can gutka tiles be used on floors?
faqs.a: Gutka is mostly used on walls, but some uses on garden paths, porches and courtyards work too. Tell Pak Clay whether the area is a wall or a floor and how it is used, and the team will advise.

faqs.q: Gutka tiles or real bricks: which is better for a front wall?
faqs.a: Gutka tiles give the look of exposed brick as a thinner facing fixed to an existing wall, so they suit renovations. Full bricks are structural. For a finish over plaster, gutka is usually the simpler choice.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Red Brick Gutka" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
